title: Love Hampers | Valentine Gift | Kado Kasih Sayang - Romance
description:
Love Hampers | Valentine Gift | Kado Kasih Sayang - Romance
Love Hampers

For Valentine, Birthday, Givethanks, etc

Product details: As shown in photos, Accessories, Artificial flower, Greetings Card, Goodie Bag

We reserve to replace any item with an equivalent valued item. Actual product may differ from photos.

Model/type according to available stock

Custom Greetings Card

PACKAGING
Packed in 'basket'
Damage and late delivery are at the buyer's risk

SHIPMENT

Shipping throughout Indonesia

INTRA CITY (Pekanbaru area) suggested GOSEND / GRAB (INSTANT COURIER)
Choose "INSTANT COURIER" for GOSEND or GRAB

INTER CITY (ANTAR KOTA ), JNE YES or JNE Reg

Packed in hard box
Packing neatly

Happy Valentine
